title: Intelligence First
subtitle: Test your understanding of Intelligence First — consciousness before matter, the Proximal Sols, Aktun and the Taran blueprint, and the fifteen soul attributes.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Return to the Intelligence First deep-dive, infographic, and video transmissions. The physical brain is an interface, not the source of mind.

questions.question: What is the primary definition of the cosmic law known as Intelligence First?

options.label: A
options.text: Individual consciousness, volition, and the capacity for thought existed billions of years prior to the creation of physical matter or biological brain structures.
options.rationale: Intelligence First is the foundational principle stating that consciousness, individual intention, and thought predated all physical matter and brain hardware by billions of years.

options.label: B
options.text: Biological brain tissue evolved through natural selection until it finally generated the capacity for thought inside living organisms, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: That is the flawed materialist view that consciousness is an emergent property of physical matter.

options.label: C
options.text: Primary intelligence emerged from primeval oceans once complex marine organisms developed nervous systems capable of thought, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Organic physical life may have begun in water, but the intelligence inhabiting it operated long before matter existed.

options.label: D
options.text: Physical matter and spiritual consciousness were created simultaneously so that a balanced experiential reality could form from the first moment, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Spiritual consciousness existed long before physical matter was even considered a feasible concept for experience.

questions.hint: Consider the timeline of consciousness relative to the existence of physical brains.

questions.question: Who are the Proximal Sols within the framework of Source Creation?

options.label: A
options.text: The Proximal Sols are the original twelve spiritual beings, consisting of six male and female pairs created directly by Source Creation.
options.rationale: Source Creation generated six pairs of complementary male and female consciousness seeds, establishing the 12 Proximal Sols as the first seeds of individualized thought.

options.label: B
options.text: The four thousand unique soul architectures designed to expand the arena of physical and spiritual experience, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The four thousand architectures were a subsequent creation forged by the original twelve beings.

options.label: C
options.text: The master creation entities responsible for engineering the hominid DNA and Taran vessel blueprints on the production lines.
options.rationale: The engineering of biological blueprints was a later task handled by Aktun, not by the Proximal Sols.

options.label: D
options.text: The parasitic controllers who downsized Taran DNA to manage incarcerated spiritual entities in third-density bodies, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The Proximal Sols are the original positive creators, not the entities managing the current containment.

questions.hint: Look for the specific number of primary consciousness seeds and their pairing.

questions.question: What is the true function of physical brain tissue under Intelligence First?

options.label: A
options.text: It acts as the primary generator of consciousness through complex electrochemical and neural firing, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Consciousness predates biological structures, making the brain a receiver rather than a generator.

options.label: B
options.text: Physical brain tissue is a downstream physical mechanism engineered to interface with pre-existing soul structures.
options.rationale: The brain is an engineered interface rather than the origin or generator of the capacity to think.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a self-evolving organ that naturally developed the capacity for metacognition and justice, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: High-level cognitive traits were embedded as firmware long before the brain was engineered for physical use.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the central source of the 15 Attributes that distinguish human souls from animal life, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The 15 Attributes are innate spiritual firmware belonging to the soul, not the physical brain tissue.

questions.hint: Think about the relationship between an interface and the source of its information.

questions.question: In which realm did fledgling spiritual consciousnesses first emerge from innocent desire?

options.label: A
options.text: Fledgling spiritual consciousnesses emerged in the highest light realms of 18th+ density.
options.rationale: Intelligence was birthed from innocent desire by fledgling spiritual consciousnesses existing in the highest light realms of 18th+ density.

options.label: B
options.text: The oceanic environments of early planets where biological organisms first began to evolve.
options.rationale: While physical life started in oceans, primary consciousness originated in high-density light realms.

options.label: C
options.text: The third-density physical matrix where Taran Vessels currently reside and experience sensory life.
options.rationale: Third density is a lower, downsized level of existence utilized much later in the cosmic timeline.

options.label: D
options.text: The subatomic matter frameworks forged by the apprentice blacksmiths of the early souls.
options.rationale: The subatomic frameworks were tools constructed by souls, not the original realm of their birth.

questions.hint: Identify the designation of the highest light realms mentioned.

questions.question: What was the result of the Proximal Sols forging two thousand additional complementary pairs?

options.label: A
options.text: The engineering of the first Taran Human blueprint off the production lines of the Aktun, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: The Taran Human was a later vessel designed for these architectures, not the architectures themselves.

options.label: B
options.text: The establishment of the Initial Intelligence known as Source Creation to guide later souls, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Source Creation was the origin of the Proximal Sols, not a result of their subsequent actions.

options.label: C
options.text: The twelve primary beings forged two thousand additional complementary pairs, yielding four thousand unique soul architectures.
options.rationale: This secondary wave of creation provided the diversity needed to expand the arena of physical and spiritual experience.

options.label: D
options.text: The development of the 15 Attributes required for high-density cognitive and spiritual function, stopping the explanation at that boundary alone.
options.rationale: The 15 Attributes were inherent traits rather than the numerical outcome of the pair expansion.

questions.hint: Calculate the total number of individuals resulting from two thousand pairs.

questions.question: How does the blacksmith analogy describe the creative process of early souls?

options.label: A
options.text: The physical brain was forged first to allow the soul a place to store its memories, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: The soul and its structural framework preceded the development of physical hardware like the brain.

options.label: B
options.text: Early souls manually constructed the structural framework of experiential reality prior to stepping into physical manifestation.
options.rationale: Just as an apprentice blacksmith crafts his own tools, early souls mastered geometry, strike pressure, cooling temperatures, and repetition before physical manifestation.

options.label: C
options.text: Souls had to learn to strike physical matter to generate the first sparks of consciousness, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Consciousness birthed from desire, not from the physical manipulation of matter or biological structures.

options.label: D
options.text: Early souls were forged in a cosmic furnace by parasitic controllers to serve as workers, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The analogy describes the proactive creation of reality by souls, not their manipulation by others.

questions.hint: Focus on what was being built by the apprentice before they stepped into their creation.

questions.question: Who is the Aktun in the context of human origins?

options.label: A
options.text: The system of fifteen innate faculties embedded in every soul at the moment of birth, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: These faculties are the 15 Attributes, which are distinct from the entity responsible for DNA.

options.label: B
options.text: The high-density creator who selects primitive biological forms as the primary vehicles of expression, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: High-density creators reject primitive forms, opting for perfected vessels like the Taran Human.

options.label: C
options.text: Aktun is the master creation entity and production-line source responsible for generating the original Taran hominid DNA blueprint.
options.rationale: The original physical blueprint was derived from the Taran Human, the latest perfected hominid vessel off the production lines of the Aktun.

options.label: D
options.text: The collective name for the six male and six female pairs birthed by Source Creation, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: The twelve original beings are designated as Proximal Sols, while Aktun is the blueprint producer.

questions.hint: Identify the entity associated with the production line of the hominid blueprint.

questions.question: What happened to the original Taran DNA when parasitic controllers took over?

options.label: A
options.text: Parasitic controllers downsized and downgraded this Taran DNA into current third-density human bodies, shrinking the brain volume and sealing off vast functional neurological centers.
options.rationale: The controllers limited the vessel to maintain control over incarcerated spiritual entities.

options.label: B
options.text: It was completely replaced by primitive primate DNA to facilitate easier biological survival, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: The Taran DNA was modified and shrunk but remains the core blueprint of the current vessel.

options.label: C
options.text: It was integrated with the 15 Attributes to create a more resilient physical container, with the surrounding architecture waved away as irrelevant.
options.rationale: The 15 Attributes are spiritual firmware and were not part of the physical DNA downsizing process.

options.label: D
options.text: It was upgraded through natural selection to adapt to the lower-density physical environment, with the surrounding architecture waved away as irrelevant.
options.rationale: The current human form is a strategic downgrade of a perfected ancestor, not an evolutionary upgrade.

questions.hint: Consider the physical changes made to the brain and DNA to facilitate incarceration.

questions.question: How are the 15 Attributes characterized within the soul?

options.label: A
options.text: They are artificial programs installed by controllers to help humans solve complex societal games.
options.rationale: The attributes are original soul firmware that controllers attempt to invert, not programs they created.

options.label: B
options.text: The 15 Attributes are innate spiritual firmware that remains intact at birth despite physical downsizing.
options.rationale: These fifteen innate faculties represent the core operating system of all positive high-density beings and cannot be deleted from the soul.

options.label: C
options.text: They are temporary psychological states that only manifest when a human is in a high-light realm.
options.rationale: These faculties represent the core operating system of all positive high-density beings across the universe.

options.label: D
options.text: They are learned cognitive behaviors developed through social interaction and physical education.
options.rationale: The attributes are pre-existing soul traits rather than qualities learned during a physical lifetime.

questions.hint: Think of these traits as the core operating system that comes pre-installed.

questions.question: What is the definition of Metacognition among the 15 Attributes?

options.label: A
options.text: Metacognition is the advanced capacity to analyze one's own thought processes, biases, and knowledge limits.
options.rationale: Metacognition involves the internal observation and evaluation of the self's cognitive state.

options.label: B
options.text: Abstract thinking is the capacity to comprehend non-physical concepts such as mathematics, philosophy, justice, and time.
options.rationale: Comprehending non-physical concepts is defined as abstract thinking within the 15 Attributes.

options.label: C
options.text: Problem-solving is the cognitive capability to analyze and formulate solutions for complex or unforeseen obstacles.
options.rationale: Formulating solutions for external obstacles is the definition of problem-solving.

options.label: D
options.text: Critical thinking is the discipline of evaluating evidence, questioning assumptions, and separating objective fact from opinion.
options.rationale: The evaluation of evidence and objective facts is the specific function of critical thinking.

questions.hint: Focus on the aspect of self-observation and thinking about thinking.

questions.question: Which attribute involves the recognition that other beings possess distinct internal mental states?

options.label: A
options.text: Altruism is the instinct to assist others purely out of cooperative unity without expecting personal reward, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Altruism is the instinct to assist others out of unity, rather than the cognitive recognition of their states.

options.label: B
options.text: Metacognition is the advanced capacity to analyze one's own thought processes, biases, and knowledge limits, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Metacognition is focused on one's own thoughts rather than the mental states of other beings.

options.label: C
options.text: Empathy is the emotional mechanism allowing a soul to actively share and comprehend the inner state of another being.
options.rationale: Empathy is specifically the emotional mechanism for sharing and comprehending another's inner state.

options.label: D
options.text: Theory of Mind is the cognitive recognition that other beings possess distinct internal mental states, desires, and beliefs.
options.rationale: This attribute allows a soul to acknowledge and understand the independent beliefs and desires of others.

questions.hint: This concept deals with understanding the mind of another person.

questions.question: Why do traditional animal containment methods fail when managing human populations?

options.label: A
options.text: Human beings possess advanced pre-existing soul intelligence derived from Taran ancestry.
options.rationale: Simple containment is insufficient for high-density souls with complex cognitive firmware, so traditional animal containment methods fail.

options.label: B
options.text: The 15 Attributes make humans naturally immune to all forms of external control.
options.rationale: Humans are not immune, but they require a much more sophisticated Human Farm for management.

options.label: C
options.text: Human bodies are physically too strong and adaptable for standard agricultural cages.
options.rationale: The failure of containment is due to soul intelligence and curiosity rather than physical strength.

options.label: D
options.text: The parasitic controllers prefer using complex financial systems over any kind of physical force.
options.rationale: Financial systems are used to occupy innate curiosity, but the reason animal methods fail is the pre-existing soul intelligence.

questions.hint: Consider what makes the human soul different from that of an animal.

questions.question: What is the specific purpose of the Human Farm?

options.label: A
options.text: To provide a nurturing environment where fledgling spiritual consciousnesses can grow into masters, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: The farm is a containment system designed by controllers, not a training ground for growth.

options.label: B
options.text: To protect Taran Vessels from the harsh environmental conditions of third density, without extending the chain into harvest or inversion logistics.
options.rationale: The farm is an artificial control environment used for management, not for protection.

options.label: C
options.text: An elaborate Human Farm occupies innate curiosity and problem-solving capacities with artificial choice architecture, societal games, financial systems, and constant visual stimulation.
options.rationale: Managing high-density souls requires engineered distractions so they do not realize their true nature.

options.label: D
options.text: To help souls regain their 15 Attributes by placing them in challenging physical scenarios, with the surrounding architecture waved away as irrelevant.
options.rationale: The farm aims to invert and weaponize the attributes, not to help the soul regain them.

questions.hint: Think about how societal games and financial systems act upon human attention.

questions.question: Which attribute allows for the mental manipulation of visual-spatial information for complex tasks?

options.label: A
options.text: Abstract thinking is the capacity to comprehend non-physical concepts such as mathematics, philosophy, justice, and time.
options.rationale: Abstract thinking focuses on non-physical concepts like justice and time rather than spatial manipulation.

options.label: B
options.text: Adaptability is the capacity to alter behavioral strategies when confronted with rapidly shifting environmental conditions.
options.rationale: Adaptability refers to altering behavioral strategies in shifting environments, not spatial memory.

options.label: C
options.text: Creativity is the synthesis of existing concepts or materials to generate novel ideas, expressions, or tools, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Creativity is the synthesis of concepts to generate novel ideas rather than the manipulation of spatial data.

options.label: D
options.text: Spatial working memory is the mental manipulation of visual-spatial information to execute complex multi-step physical tasks.
options.rationale: This faculty is essential for planning and executing multi-step physical tasks in a spatial context.

questions.hint: Identify the attribute that specifically mentions visual-spatial information.

questions.question: What is Altruism among the 15 Attributes?

options.label: A
options.text: Empathy is the emotional mechanism allowing a soul to actively share and comprehend the inner state of another being.
options.rationale: Sharing the emotional state of another is the definition of Empathy, not Altruism.

options.label: B
options.text: Impulse control is the capacity to forgo immediate smaller rewards to secure superior long-term outcomes.
options.rationale: Forgoing immediate rewards is defined as Impulse control or delayed gratification.

options.label: C
options.text: Altruism is the instinct to assist others purely out of cooperative unity without expecting personal reward.
options.rationale: Altruism is a core high-density trait based on cooperative unity among souls.

options.label: D
options.text: Grit and perseverance is the sustained application of effort toward long-term objectives despite failure and adversity.
options.rationale: Sustained effort toward a goal is defined as Grit and perseverance.

questions.hint: Look for the trait that emphasizes cooperation without reward.

questions.question: What is the strategic implication of recognizing that intelligence preceded physicality?

options.label: A
options.text: It suggests that the 15 Attributes can only be activated after the physical brain is fully developed, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The attributes are soul firmware and are present even when the physical brain is downsized.

options.label: B
options.text: It proves that human beings must wait for a physical upgrade from the Aktun to reach higher densities, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Sovereignty is found in recognizing pre-existing intelligence, not in waiting for a physical upgrade.

options.label: C
options.text: It confirms that the Human Farm is a necessary step for the soul to learn how to manipulate matter, with no further layer required beyond that account.
options.rationale: The souls already mastered matter manipulation long before entering the physical Human Farm.

options.label: D
options.text: Recognizing that intelligence preceded physicality dismantles the foundational narrative of materialist science and biological evolution.
options.rationale: Understanding that the physical brain is merely an interface rather than the source of mind restores direct awareness of primary spiritual sovereignty.

questions.hint: Focus on the restoration of self-awareness and the rejection of materialist evolution.

questions.question: Which attribute involves utilizing complex language and metaphors to transmit knowledge?

options.label: A
options.text: Theory of Mind is the cognitive recognition that other beings possess distinct internal mental states, desires, and beliefs.
options.rationale: Theory of Mind is the recognition of others' mental states, not the system used to communicate with them.

options.label: B
options.text: Metacognition is the advanced capacity to analyze one's own thought processes, biases, and knowledge limits, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: Metacognition is an internal analysis of thought rather than an external method of communication.

options.label: C
options.text: Symbolic communication is the utilization of complex language, visual symbols, and metaphors to transmit knowledge across generations.
options.rationale: This trait allows for the transmission of intelligence across generations through visual and linguistic symbols.

options.label: D
options.text: Abstract thinking is the capacity to comprehend non-physical concepts such as mathematics, philosophy, justice, and time.
options.rationale: Abstract thinking is the comprehension of the concepts, while symbolic communication is their transmission.

questions.hint: Look for the term that includes symbols and language.

questions.question: What does the attribute of Impulse control allow a soul to do?

options.label: A
options.text: Adaptability is the capacity to alter behavioral strategies when confronted with rapidly shifting environmental conditions.
options.rationale: Altering strategies for shifting environments is the definition of Adaptability.

options.label: B
options.text: Grit and perseverance is the sustained application of effort toward long-term objectives despite failure and adversity.
options.rationale: Sustained effort despite failure is the definition of Grit and perseverance.

options.label: C
options.text: Impulse control is the capacity to forgo immediate smaller rewards to secure superior long-term outcomes.
options.rationale: This capacity, also known as delayed gratification, is a key component of high-density cognitive firmware.

options.label: D
options.text: Emotional regulation is the ability to modify internal emotional states to maintain balance within stressful environments.
options.rationale: Modifying internal emotional states is the definition of Emotional regulation.

questions.hint: Think about the timing of rewards and the ability to wait.

questions.question: Why did controlling entities weaponize and invert the 15 Attributes?

options.label: A
options.text: They wanted to enhance the problem-solving skills of the incarcerated souls for better labor.
options.rationale: They use these skills inside Human Farm games, but their ultimate goal is control, not enhancement.

options.label: B
options.text: These fifteen qualities are intrinsic to primary intelligence and cannot be deleted from the soul.
options.rationale: Because the controllers could not delete the firmware, they were forced to systematically invert and weaponize each attribute to construct an artificial control environment.

options.label: C
options.text: The 15 Attributes were originally created by the controllers to test human potential in the farm.
options.rationale: The attributes are original soul firmware from the light realms, not creations of the controllers.

options.label: D
options.text: They wanted to help humans evolve more quickly into the next stage of Taran development.
options.rationale: The goal of the controllers is containment and management, not the evolution of the souls.

questions.hint: Consider why you would try to change something you cannot destroy.

questions.question: In the Intelligence First model, where did the impulse to think originally come from?

options.label: A
options.text: A mandate from Source Creation that all souls must inhabit a physical container, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Source Creation birthed the souls, but the impulse to think was an innate expression of the souls themselves.

options.label: B
options.text: The necessity of solving environmental obstacles in the primeval physical oceans, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Intelligence operated before matter, meaning the impulse to think preceded any physical environment.

options.label: C
options.text: Intelligence was birthed from innocent desire by fledgling spiritual consciousnesses in the highest light realms.
options.rationale: The drive for existence and thought birthed from innocent desire before physical form was ever established.

options.label: D
options.text: The activation of complex neurological centers in the early Taran Human brain, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: The brain centers were constructed long after the impulse to think was already established.

questions.hint: Identify the feeling or state that first birthed consciousness.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the Taran Vessel?

options.label: A
options.text: Taran Vessels serve as the biological bridge connecting this primordial intelligence to the physical matrix.
options.rationale: These engineered containers allow pre-existing intelligences to inhabit physical form and experience sensory existence.

options.label: B
options.text: To house the artificial intelligence used by the Aktun to monitor soul activity, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Taran Vessels are for the souls' expression, not for monitoring by artificial intelligence.

options.label: C
options.text: To generate the 15 Attributes through the interaction of DNA and the physical environment, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The attributes are soul firmware that exists independently of the vessel's biological DNA.

options.label: D
options.text: To replace the original soul architectures with a more efficient physical brain, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The vessel is a container for the architecture, not a replacement for the soul's structure.

questions.hint: Consider what a bridge does for two different realms.

questions.question: Which of these is identified as a core cognitive trait in the 15 Attributes?

options.label: A
options.text: Submission is an innate high-density faculty built into original soul firmware for obedience, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: The original firmware is based on sovereignty and intelligence, not on submissiveness.

options.label: B
options.text: Materialism is an innate high-density trait that orients the soul toward physical matter as mind, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Materialism is an inverted narrative used for control, not an innate attribute of the soul.

options.label: C
options.text: Problem-solving is the cognitive capability to analyze and formulate solutions for complex or unforeseen obstacles.
options.rationale: This attribute allows for the analysis and formulation of solutions for complex or unforeseen obstacles.

options.label: D
options.text: Natural selection is one of the fifteen innate faculties embedded as soul firmware at birth, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Natural selection is a biological concept that Intelligence First identifies as a flawed narrative.

questions.hint: This trait is focused on overcoming obstacles and finding solutions.

questions.question: Why would high-density creators never select primitive biological forms as their primary vehicles of expression?

options.label: A
options.text: Primitive forms are too spiritually fragile to hold the power of Source Creation, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: The limitation is the mismatch between high-density intentionality and low-density primitive forms.

options.label: B
options.text: High-density creators capable of manipulating subatomic matter through pure intentionality would never select low-density, primitive biological forms.
options.rationale: Creators with such power would only manifest through perfected, high-capacity vessels such as the Taran Human.

options.label: C
options.text: Parasitic controllers have blocked all access to lower-density evolutionary paths, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: Creators choose their vehicles. Controllers merely downsized what was already created.

options.label: D
options.text: The Aktun production lines refuse to work with any DNA that is not of Taran origin, and declining any account that reaches past that point.
options.rationale: The Aktun produced the Taran DNA specifically to meet the standards of high-density creators.

questions.hint: Consider the relationship between pure intention and the matter it manipulates.

questions.question: True or False: The conventional assertion that human intellect evolved from primates is considered fundamentally flawed in this reality framework.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: The conventional assertion that human intellect evolved from primates or marine life is fundamentally flawed. Intellect preceded all biological life.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Primary consciousness did not emerge from biological primeval oceans, nor did it evolve through natural selection from primitive organisms.

questions.hint: Does this framework support or reject the standard theory of biological brain evolution?

questions.question: True or False: The 15 Attributes can be permanently deleted from a soul if the physical brain is sufficiently downsized.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Despite physical downsizing, the fundamental spiritual firmware of the soul remains intact at birth through 15 Attributes.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: These fifteen qualities are intrinsic to primary intelligence and cannot be deleted from the soul. Controllers can only invert and weaponize them.

questions.hint: Can the spiritual operating system be removed by changing the physical hardware?
